Leah (AE): Quick sync 1: OrionHealth wants a short POC: WS/SSE streaming, function calls that return strict JSON (no HTML), reserved-capacity ballpark, and SQ answers.
Sam (Presales): Scope: 1) streaming handshake, 2) two function/tool calls with JSON schema, 3) ephemeral creds for connector, 4) latency target ~120ms p50 for ~500-token replies, 5) on-prem or VPC option for PHI.
Marta (OrionHealth): Correct. Also need logs exportable to our SIEM and embedding storage only inside our VPC.
Ravi (SDK Eng): We can demo with Python/Go SDKs. Minimal WS snippet: `client.ws_stream(model="rwd-med", prompt="extract")` -> stream yields `tool_call` events containing JSON. We'll emit `validation_failed` events if schema mismatch.
Jules (Security): We'll prepare SQ answers: SOC2 status, TLS, AES-256 KMS, key rotation, audit logs, on-prem responsibilities. Need the questionnaire file.
Leah (AE): Marta will upload the SQ today. Pricing ask: 2-rack equivalent (peak ~300 qps, avg ~80 qps) 1 what ballpark?
Ravi (SDK Eng): Ballpark Dedicated: $12k
$20k/mo depending on quantization/batching; add one-time eng fee for HSM/KMS on-prem. Finalize after token histogram.
Sam (Presales): POC plan: Day 0 hosted sandbox (2 days) validate handshake+schema; Day 3-7 Dedicated perf tests; Optional Private after agreement. Keep scope tight.
Leah (AE): Action items: Leah upload SQ + invite for 30m tech kickoff; Ravi prepare demo + runbook; Jules draft answers; Pricing ops draft two quote paths.
RedwoodBot: Deploy sandbox rwd-sb-47 complete 1 demo: https://sandbox.redwood.local/streams/orion
Marta (OrionHealth): Thanks. Please include a latency runbook and short-lived OIDC example.
Ravi (SDK Eng): Will attach runbook and ephemeral token sample in demo repo.
Leah (AE): Great, following up after SQ upload. :thumbsup:
